root cause: `npabridge/payload.py` emitted the dladdr result check as `cbnz w0, publish_old`, but dladdr reports success with a non-zero result, so a successful lookup was treated as a failure; the basename scan also stopped at the first '/', so an absolute dli_fname could never match its basename. Both were present since the first payload commit b146213, so the dispatch had never activated

fix: test the dladdr result with CBZ and compare the final path component (the scan reaches the NUL, then steps back over the basename and requires the preceding byte to be '/'). `npabridge.payload` now asserts both shapes on every assembly

runtime proof: macOS PlayCover, iPhone-SE-class app, installed bundle carrying the fixed payload. Before the fix the libass unit state word read 3 (OLD) while LibASSBridge.dylib was loaded and dlsym returned its symbol; after the fix the three unit state words read 2 (NEW) and every slot holds a bridge address

root cause: the app's FFmpeg 4.4 still numbers three AVPixelFormat members that 9.0.2 removed (AV_PIX_FMT_VAAPI_MOCO, AV_PIX_FMT_VAAPI_IDCT, AV_PIX_FMT_XVMC) and they sit inside the enum, so every value from legacy 46 on is shifted (+2 up to 153, +3 after). The swscale shims forwarded the app's value straight through, so AV_PIX_FMT_P010LE (legacy 161) was read by 9.0.2 as AV_PIX_FMT_GBRAP12LE (4 planes, 16-bit)

symptom before the fix: P010/HEVC folder thumbnails rendered garbage on macOS (lower half green, no crash) and crashed on iOS; 8-bit H.264 was unaffected because NV12 (23), YUV420P (0) and the RGB24 destination (2) are not renumbered

fix (commit 05423b2): npa_modern_pixfmt() translates src and dst in npa_sws_getContext and npa_sws_getCachedContext. The three dropped members and any value outside the 4.4 enum become AV_PIX_FMT_NONE so sws_getContext fails instead of scaling with a format that means something else. The magic numbers (46, 153, 198 and the dropped-before counts 2 and 3) are named constants documented in the source and the commit message

two defects were found and fixed during this pass, both in the shim: (1) the shadow codecpar->extradata aliased the modern buffer, so the app's av_freep of attachment extradata double-freed at the modern close (SIGABRT in codec_parameters_reset); the shadow now owns a copy. (2) libavcodec/libavutil renumber AVCodecID and AVPixelFormat across major versions, so the copied values mis-resolved (HEVC 172 vs 173, VP9 166 vs 167, AV1 222 vs 32797, ASS 94230 vs 96269, OTF 98310 vs 100355, YUV420P10LE 62 vs 64). A compiler-generated name-based table (deps/gen_demux_enum_map.py) now translates codec_id and format. This is why HEVC/WebM and the embedded subtitle/fonts failed before. Neither the demux (open/find_stream_info returned 0 and read_frame only reached EOF) nor the app's decode path was at fault
